I'd drop my calories to 900. And somehow I'd be up 10 pounds by the next month.

I remember coming out of the shower that Sunday afternoon.

 

Looking at myself for a while. How much uglier my body had gotten. How much puffier my face had gotten.

 

Then I saw my best friend's post. Me, 2 years ago.

 

I threw my phone on the counter. I was comfortable gaslighting myself into thinking I didn't look THAT much different. Even though I'd gained 60 pounds over 2 years.

 

I wept and ran to my bed. Searching for solutions, I ended up sleeping in my puddle of tears. With nothing on.

 

Woke 5 hours later at 8 PM. Still tired. With the biggest headache and that coldness I constantly feel 24/7.

 

I opened my phone to text my mother that I give up. That I had to pull a loan and get the surgery.

 

But I was still on Reddit. And I saw people talking about this "Dr. Margaret."

 

It was weird. I'd never seen so many people in a thread talk about 1 person.
